title: Reason Code 117: the remote RADIUS server did not respond
plain_english: This NPS proxied the request to a remote RADIUS server group and got no answer within the timeout, so it rejected the user locally. The credentials were never evaluated. A remote server that does not know this proxy, or disagrees on the shared secret, drops packets silently and looks exactly like a server that is down.

any: remote RADIUS server did not respond

causes.cause: The remote server is down or UDP 1812 is blocked from this proxy.
causes.next_check: From the NPS proxy, send a test request to the remote server (authhound-probe or NTRadPing) with the group's shared secret; check firewall rules for UDP 1812/1813 in both directions.

causes.cause: The remote server does not have this proxy as a RADIUS client, or the shared secret differs, so it drops the request silently.
causes.next_check: On the remote server look for 'unknown client' / 'Shared secret is incorrect' (FreeRADIUS -X) or System-log event 13 / 6274 (NPS) with this proxy's IP.

causes.cause: The remote server group's timeout is too short for a slow backend (for example a remote MFA step).
causes.next_check: NPS console > Remote RADIUS Server Groups > the group > server > Load Balancing tab: raise 'Number of seconds without response before request is considered dropped'.
